description: A distributed research collective discovers a training method that dramatically reduces the compute required to reach frontier capabilities, using algorithmic efficiency gains from meta-learning and sparse activation. This accelerates open replication and threatens to compress the closed-open capability gap further, especially as the technique spreads through underground research forums.

Cities across the EU begin forming a decentralized oversight network to monitor local AI deployments in public services, using shared audit frameworks and citizen reporting tools. Driven by distrust in central institutions and recent scandals, this grassroots coordination emerges independently of EU policy and begins to set de facto standards for transparency and accountability at the municipal level.
